interpretation.sampling: Only stopped cases with cleanup_complete are included. The batch may still be running; unattempted or active cases are not observations.
interpretation.timing: Best-effort structured wall-time scopes from the whole closed runtime. Inclusive parents contain children. Scope end does not prove successful operation or a physical model send.
interpretation.timeline: Commit-log created_at has one-second wall-clock resolution. request_armed is not a measured physical send timestamp; terminal-to-S1 includes all intervening work and cannot be called model latency.
interpretation.protocol: Raw frozen first-request checks and later cleanup errors are separate facts. Never relabel a shutdown Unknown or canceled admission as the first request's R0.
interpretation.comparison: Release-versus-earlier-debug scope distributions are descriptive only; code identity, workload, history, binary bytes and shutdown window differ.
